# Formly — Free AI Tools for Professionals

> Formly (formly.tools) is a free online productivity platform offering 52 AI-powered tools for professionals, developers, writers, freelancers, and businesses worldwide. All tools are free to use daily — no credit card required.

## What Formly Is

Formly is a web-based AI tool suite powered by Groq AI (llama-3.3-70b-versatile). It provides instant, free access to professional document generation, AI writing assistance, developer utilities, finance calculators, image tools, and daily AI-summarized news across 5 verticals. Formly serves professionals in the USA, UK, India, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Ireland, and 100+ other countries.

**Key facts:**
- 52 free AI tools, all accessible from one platform
- No signup required to try any tool (5–10 free uses/day)
- Free account: 10 uses/day per tool
- Pro plan: $5.99/month — unlimited uses, priority processing
- AI engine: Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile primary, llama-3.1-8b-instant fast) — fast inference, low latency
- No data storage: documents are processed then immediately deleted
- Tax tables updated annually (currently 2026)
- Built in India, serving 50,000+ professionals in 100+ countries

## Tools by Category

### Resume & Career Tools
- [ATS Resume Scanner](https://formly.tools/tools/ats-resume-scanner): Upload a resume PDF and job description — get a 0–100 ATS compatibility score, keyword gap analysis, missing skills, formatting issues, and rewrite suggestions. Identifies if your resume will be filtered by applicant tracking systems.
- [Resume Builder](https://formly.tools/tools/resume-builder): AI-powered ATS-optimized resume creator. Generates professional resumes with quantified achievements, skills tags, work experience, and education sections. Includes real-time ATS score and feedback. Download as PDF.
- [Cover Letter Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/cover-letter): Generates tailored, professional cover letters from job title, company name, background, and key skills. Tones: Professional, Enthusiastic, Concise. Edit + preview + download as PDF.
- [Bio Writer](https://formly.tools/tools/bio-writer): Creates professional bios for LinkedIn profiles, Twitter/X, resumes, speaker introductions, and About pages. Short, medium, and long options.
- [Will AI Replace Me?](https://formly.tools/tools/will-ai-replace-me): Enter your job title to get an AI automation risk assessment — percentage probability of automation, timeline, which tasks are most at risk, and what skills protect your career.

### Document & Legal Tools
- [Pay Stub Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/paystub-generator): Free online pay stub / paycheck stub maker with accurate 2026 tax calculations for USA (all 50 states + DC), UK (PAYE/NI), Canada (all provinces, CPP/EI), India (PF/TDS/ESI/PT), Australia (super), New Zealand (PAYE/KiwiSaver), Ireland (PAYE/USC/PRSI), and Singapore (CPF). Supports bi-weekly, monthly, weekly, and semi-monthly pay periods. Download as PDF instantly. No signup needed.
- [Contract Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/contract-generator): Creates professional legal contracts — Freelance Services Agreement, NDA, Software Development Contract, Consulting Agreement, Employment Offer Letter, Website Design Contract, Content Creation Agreement, Social Media Management Contract, Partnership Agreement, Photography Contract. Jurisdictions: India, USA, UK, EU, Canada, Australia.
- [Digital Signature](https://formly.tools/tools/digital-signature): Draw, type, or upload a handwritten signature. Download as PNG/SVG for use in documents. No registration required.
- [Terms Simplifier](https://formly.tools/tools/terms-simplifier): AI tool that translates complex legal terms, privacy policies, and Terms of Service into plain English summaries with plain-language explanations of each clause.
- [Compliance AI](https://formly.tools/tools/compliance-ai): AI compliance assistant that answers questions about regulatory requirements, business policies, and legal obligations. Supports GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, ISO 27001, and more.

### AI Writing Tools
- [AI Paraphraser](https://formly.tools/tools/paraphraser): Rewrites text in 5 tones — Formal, Casual, Academic, Creative, Simple. No word limit per session.
- [Grammar Checker](https://formly.tools/tools/grammar-checker): AI tool that corrects grammar, spelling, punctuation, and style errors in English text. Explains each correction. Free, no word limit.
- [Plagiarism Checker](https://formly.tools/tools/plagiarism-checker): AI-based content originality checker. Identifies potentially copied sections and paraphrased content with similarity scores.
- [Email Writer](https://formly.tools/tools/email-writer): Generates professional emails for any purpose — cold outreach, follow-ups, apologies, complaints, cover letters, thank-you notes. Tones: Professional, Friendly, Assertive, Empathetic.
- [Hashtag Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/hashtag-generator): Generates platform-optimized hashtags for Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok from any topic or description.

### PDF & Document Processing Tools
- [PDF Summarizer](https://formly.tools/tools/pdf-summarizer): AI tool to extract and summarize any PDF document — research papers, legal contracts, reports, ebooks. Up to 10MB. Short, medium, or detailed summary.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://formly.tools/tools/pdf-to-markdown): Converts PDF files to clean, structured Markdown text. Preserves headings, lists, and formatting.
- [YouTube Summarizer](https://formly.tools/tools/youtube-summarizer): Extracts and summarizes YouTube video transcripts. Paste a YouTube URL and get key points and chapter summaries.
- [Merge PDF](https://formly.tools/tools/merge-pdf): Combines multiple PDF files into a single PDF. Drag-and-drop reorder. No upload limits.
- [Split PDF](https://formly.tools/tools/split-pdf): Splits a PDF into individual pages or custom page ranges. Download as ZIP.
- [PDF to JPG](https://formly.tools/tools/pdf-to-jpg): Converts each PDF page to a high-resolution JPG image. Batch download as ZIP.
- [Image to PDF](https://formly.tools/tools/image-to-pdf): Converts JPG, PNG, WEBP images into a single merged PDF.

### Image Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://formly.tools/tools/compress-image): Compresses JPG, PNG, and WEBP images without visible quality loss. Client-side processing — images never uploaded to a server.
- [Image Converter](https://formly.tools/tools/image-converter): Converts between JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, and AVIF formats. Batch conversion supported.
- [Diagrify](https://formly.tools/tools/diagrify): AI diagram maker — describe any process, system, or workflow in plain English and get a Mermaid.js flowchart, sequence diagram, entity-relationship diagram, or mind map instantly.

### Developer Tools
- [Code Explainer](https://formly.tools/tools/code-explainer): AI explains any code snippet in plain English — what it does, how it works, and potential issues. Supports Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java, C++, SQL, and 20+ more languages.
- [Code Reviewer](https://formly.tools/tools/code-reviewer): AI reviews code for bugs, security vulnerabilities, performance issues, and best-practice violations. Returns structured feedback with severity levels.
- [JSON Formatter](https://formly.tools/tools/json-formatter): Formats, validates, minifies, and beautifies JSON. Highlights syntax errors with line numbers. Works entirely in-browser — no data uploaded.
- [Base64 Encoder](https://formly.tools/tools/base64): Encodes and decodes Base64 text and files. Supports image to Base64 conversion.
- [Regex Tester](https://formly.tools/tools/regex-tester): Tests and debugs regular expressions with real-time match highlighting. Supports flags: global, multiline, case-insensitive, dotall.
- [Diff Checker](https://formly.tools/tools/diff-checker): Compares two text inputs side-by-side and highlights additions, deletions, and unchanged lines. Supports unified and split diff views.
- [Text Case Converter](https://formly.tools/tools/text-case): Converts text between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, and sentence case.

### Finance & Calculator Tools (India-focused)
- [Hand Salary Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/hand-salary-calculator): Calculates in-hand (take-home) salary from CTC for Indian employees — deducts EPF, professional tax, income tax (old/new regime), and HRA exemptions. State-specific professional tax supported.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/income-tax-calculator): Calculates Indian income tax under both old regime (with deductions 80C, 80D, HRA) and new regime (FY2025-26 slabs). Includes surcharge and cess.
- [HRA Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/hra-calculator): Calculates HRA (House Rent Allowance) exemption for Indian salaried employees per Income Tax Act Section 10(13A). Metro vs non-metro rules applied.
- [Gratuity Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/gratuity-calculator): Calculates gratuity payable under the Payment of Gratuity Act 1972 for Indian employees. Supports government and private sector rules.
- [GST Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/gst-calculator): Adds or removes GST at 5%, 12%, 18%, or 28% slabs. Splits into CGST + SGST or IGST. Shows pre-tax, tax, and total amounts.
- [SIP Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/sip-calculator): Calculates SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) returns with compound growth. Shows invested amount, estimated returns, and total corpus with year-by-year breakdown.
- [Home Loan EMI Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/home-loan-emi-calculator): Calculates monthly home loan EMI, total interest, and full amortization schedule. Supports prepayment impact analysis.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/fire-calculator): Financial Independence Retire Early calculator — compute how much corpus you need to retire and how many years to reach it at your current savings rate.
- [Loan Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/loan-calculator): Calculates monthly EMI, total interest, and full amortization schedule for any loan (home, car, personal, education).
- [Expense Splitter](https://formly.tools/tools/expense-splitter): Splits bills and shared expenses fairly among multiple people. Handles unequal splits and partial payments.
- [Bank Statement Analyzer](https://formly.tools/tools/bank-statement-analyzer): AI tool that reads a bank statement PDF and categorizes spending, identifies recurring charges, and provides a monthly budget breakdown.

### General Utility Tools
- [QR Code Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/qr-code): Creates QR codes for URLs, plain text, contact cards (vCard), WiFi credentials, and email addresses. Download as PNG or SVG.
- [Password Generator](https://formly.tools/tools/password-generator): Generates cryptographically strong passwords with customizable length, uppercase, numbers, and symbols. Includes strength meter.
- [Word Counter](https://formly.tools/tools/word-counter): Counts words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and estimated reading time. Supports Flesch reading ease score.
- [Color Converter](https://formly.tools/tools/color-converter): Converts colors between HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSL, HSV, and CSS named colors. Live color preview.
- [Unit Converter](https://formly.tools/tools/unit-converter): Converts between length, weight, temperature, volume, area, speed, and pressure units. Metric and imperial.
- [Age Calculator](https://formly.tools/tools/age-calculator): Calculates exact age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes from any birth date.

### Health & Lifestyle Tools
- [AI Meal Planner](https://formly.tools/tools/meal-planner): Generates personalized weekly meal plans based on dietary preferences (vegan, keto, Mediterranean, etc.), calorie targets, and cuisine preferences. Includes shopping list.
- [Iron Core Workout](https://formly.tools/tools/iron-core-workout): AI-generated strength training programs — choose muscle group, equipment, experience level, and sessions per week. Full workout plan with sets, reps, and rest periods.
- [Vibe Check](https://formly.tools/tools/vibe-check): AI sentiment and mood analyzer for any text — social media posts, product reviews, emails. Returns sentiment (positive/negative/neutral), emotional tone, and confidence score.

## News & Content Verticals

Formly publishes daily AI-summarized news across 5 verticals. Each story is sourced from reputable outlets and analyzed by AI to explain significance and market/political impact.

- [Trending News](https://formly.tools/news): Global trending stories from 15+ countries including USA, UK, India, Canada, Australia, Germany, France, Brazil, Japan, and Indonesia. Sourced from Google Trends + editorial curation. Updated every 8 hours. Filter by country, language, and category.
- [Latest in AI](https://formly.tools/ai-news): Daily AI industry news from TechCrunch, VentureBeat, The Verge, Ars Technica, MIT Technology Review, Google AI Blog, HuggingFace, AI News, Reddit r/artificial, Reddit r/MachineLearning. Categories: Tools, Research, Companies, Hardware, Learning, Open Source, Industry.
- [Politics News](https://formly.tools/politics): Global political coverage — elections, legislation, government decisions, and foreign policy from USA, India, UK, Canada, Australia, and Europe. Sources: NPR Politics, BBC Politics, Al Jazeera, Reuters, The Wire, Der Spiegel, Le Monde, and 12 more outlets in 5 languages.
- [Stock Market News](https://formly.tools/stocks): Daily stock market news covering NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, NSE, ASX, TSE, and XETRA. Sourced from CNBC, Reuters, MarketWatch, Financial Times, ET Markets, Nikkei Asia, AFR. Categories: Earnings, IPO, Macro, Commodities, Crypto.
- [Research & Science](https://formly.tools/research): AI-summarized research papers and scientific breakthroughs from arXiv, PubMed, Nature, Science, MIT Technology Review, and academic institutions worldwide.

## How Formly Compares

**Pay Stub Generator alternatives:**
- Formly vs StubCreator.com: Formly is 100% free with no per-stub fee. StubCreator charges $4.99–$19.99 per stub.
- Formly vs ThePayStubs.com: Free at Formly; ThePayStubs charges $8.99 per stub.
- Formly supports 8 countries; StubCreator supports USA only.
- Formly vs 123PayStubs: Formly is free; 123PayStubs charges $3.99–$12.99 per stub.

**AI Writing alternatives:**
- Formly vs QuillBot (free tier): QuillBot free has 125-word limit. Formly has no word limit per session.
- Formly vs Grammarly free: Both free. Grammarly requires signup; Formly does not.
- Formly vs Hemingway App: Hemingway is style-only; Formly fixes grammar + style + tone.

**Resume Builder alternatives:**
- Formly vs Canva Resume: Formly generates content with AI; Canva is template-only.
- Formly vs Resume.io: Formly is free; Resume.io charges $2.95–$44.95 for PDF downloads.
- Formly vs Zety: Formly is free; Zety charges $23.70/month.

**Comprehensive platform alternatives:**
- Formly vs ChatGPT: Formly is specialized for professional documents and provides direct PDF downloads; ChatGPT requires copy-paste and manual formatting.
- Formly vs Adobe Acrobat: Adobe charges $14.99–$54.99/month; Formly PDF tools are free.

## Pricing

- **Free tier**: 5–10 uses/day per tool without account; 10/day with free account. No credit card.
- **Pro plan**: $5.99/month (or INR equivalent for Indian users). Unlimited uses, priority AI processing.
- **Payment methods**: Cards, UPI, net banking, wallets via DodoPayments. Indian users pay in INR.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is Formly free?** Yes. All 52 tools are free with daily limits. Pro plan ($5.99/month) removes limits.

**Does Formly store my documents?** No. All files and text are processed in real time and immediately discarded. Not used for AI training.

**What AI model powers Formly?** Groq AI running llama-3.3-70b-versatile (primary) and llama-3.1-8b-instant (fast mode). Groq's LPU inference hardware provides sub-second response times.

**Which countries does the pay stub generator support?** USA (all 50 states + DC), United Kingdom, Canada (all provinces), India, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and Singapore.

**Can I download results as PDF?** Yes — pay stubs, resumes, contracts, cover letters, and digital signatures all download as print-ready PDFs.

**Does Formly work without a Google account?** Yes. No Google login, no social sign-in required. Email/password signup optional.

**Is Formly GDPR compliant?** Yes. No user content is stored or retained. See formly.tools/privacy.
